tab_Work Orders: Organization Invoice Work Orders WORKFLOW Require Approval for New Lines When on, new work order lines require approval. When off, they are auto-approved. Require Review Before Completion Work orders must be reviewed and signed off before they can be completed LINE REQUIREMENTS Require Tech Story Tech story will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order Require Mileage Mileage will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order Require Engine Hours Engine hours will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order PARTS Require Ordering Parts When on, you click Order on each part to record that you've ordered it. When off, parts are marked as ordered automatically. Require Receiving Parts Before Completion When on, each part must be recorded as received before the work order can be completed, reviewed or invoiced. When off, you can finish the work order and receive later. Require Picking Inventory Parts When on, you click Pick on each inventory and found part to record that it's been pulled. When off, these parts are ready as soon as the line is approved. Save Settings

invimp: Invoices Import Preview cloud_upload Select CSV File cloud_download Download Template Import Invoices To do a invoices import you need to have a csv file with following columns: Shop Location, Customer, VIN, Year, Make, Model, Unit #, Unit Type, Mileage, Hours, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, PO, Service Advisor, Item, Line Title, Line Description, Tech Story, Part #, Part Description, Qty, Rate, Total, Tax Amount. Your file's first row must contain these columns. Also, new line separator is used for new row, comma for columns. Your rows must contain valid values for all required columns, otherwise all rows associated with that invoice will be skipped.
